criterionOutcomes.criterion: In GIS, with an available Surveyor layer loaded, the layer legend exposes Display Settings; opening Display Settings shows the Show linked sites checkbox with an identifiable initial checked or unchecked state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Screenshots show the Surveyor layer legend and Display Settings with Show linked sites checked.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Selecting the Show linked sites checkbox changes its displayed state to the opposite checked or unchecked state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Screenshots show Show linked sites checked before selection and unchecked afterward.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: After closing and reopening Display Settings, the Show linked sites checkbox displays the changed state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Screenshots show the unchecked state, settings closed, then reopened with the checkbox still unchecked.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: After restoring Show linked sites to its recorded initial state, closing and reopening Display Settings displays that original state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Screenshots show checked initially, unchecked after change, restored to checked, then checked after closing and reopening.
